signals.title: Opvolgers Lagarde: standpunten kandidaten over bitcoin, stablecoins en CBDCs
signals.summary: Changing of Lagarde: How the candidates to be next ECB president view bitcoin, stablecoins and CBDCs

signals.title: Europese Commissie wil MiCA uitbreiden voor tokenisering en niet-EU stablecoin-emittenten
signals.summary: The European Commission is reportedly seeking comment from stakeholders on expanding MiCA rules until Sept. 30.

signals.title: Boris Johnson steunt tokenisering ondanks eerdere kritiek op crypto
signals.summary: Boris Johnson backed blockchain and tokenization at Solana Breakpoint but reiterated his concerns about crypto speculation.

signals.title: ECB en EU centrale banken willen MiCA-depositorequirements voor stablecoins aanpassen
signals.summary: The ECB and EU central banks want to replace MiCA’s stablecoin bank-deposit requirements with liquidity thresholds, warning that sudden withdrawals could strain lenders.

signals.title: EBA publiceert ontwerpmethodologie voor boeterollen onder MiCA
signals.summary: ​The European Banking Authority (EBA) published today a Consultation Paper with a draft methodology for setting fines in its role as supervisor under MiCA. The objective is to ensure that fines imposed on issuers of significant crypto-assets are consistent, proportionate and transparent, and effectively support compliance with the regulatory framework.

signals.title: Braziliaanse centrale bank onder druk vanwege uitspraken over stablecoin witwassen
signals.summary: Brazil's central bank faces backlash over stablecoin money laundering remarks

signals.title: Zelle gebruikt Solana voor ZelleUSD stablecoin en internationaal betalingsverkeer
signals.summary: Zelle plans to use Solana for its ZelleUSD stablecoin and international payments, with confidential transfers designed to hide payment amounts.

signals.title: EBA steunt verdere voortgang Bankenunie, inclusief depositogarantie
signals.summary: The EBA supports further progress on the Banking Union, including on deposit insurance, as a key step towards a more efficient and resilient European banking system.
